facts.fact: The Lesotho Times reports that a government freeze on issuing refugee identity cards and travel documents, begun in July 2025 after corruption allegations against refugee and passport officials, was still in force in its second year, with hundreds of refugees left without valid documents.
facts.system: refugee identity cards and travel documents

facts.fact: The chairperson of the Refugees Welfare Committee says refugees cannot access M-Pesa, Mukuru or banking because their documents have lapsed, and some bank accounts have been frozen.

systems.system: Refugee identity card and travel document issuance (Office of the Commissioner for Refugees)
